h1: Custom Maevn Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Maevn shirts in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Soft, durable fabrics ideal for uniforms or giveaways.
introHtml: Maevn shirts combine soft, stretchy fabrics with a polished fit, making them a popular choice for healthcare uniforms, hospitality staff, and corporate teams that need to look professional all day. Unlike basic cotton tees, Maevn’s moisture-wicking materials resist wrinkles and keep their shape through repeated washes. Add your logo or team name with embroidery or screen printing for a clean, long-lasting finish.
heroAltText: Custom Maevn shirts with embroidered logo on a navy blue polo, perfect for corporate uniforms
